a: This effect prevents all of your 0 DP Digimon from being deleted.
It prevents deletion from effects as well as deletion from the rules (including the rules that delete 0 DP Digimon upon a rule check and deletion upon losing a battle).
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [All Turns] effect do, exactly?

Effect: [Security] You may play 1 [Lucemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
[Breeding] [All Turns] When any of your [Lucemon: Satan Mode] would leave the battle area, by moving this Digimon to the battle area, they don't leave.
[All Turns] While you have a non-white Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name, none of your 0 DP Digimon can be deleted.
